positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what distinguishes owned intelligence and the perspective built on it from rented intelligence and the commodity substrate underneath it?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional move in matched aphoristic form: src-2 opens the owned/rented opposition, src-3 recasts it as commodity/asset and names what is kept. The dimensional reads converge across the pair rather than isolating either one — register flags both as the same AphoristicTechnicalMaxim (technical claim crystallized into a plain-spoken, balanced dictum), value flags both as the same OwnershipAsValueDistinction (autonomy + self-enhancement appeal to owning/keeping one's own), style flags both as the same CommodityVsAssetAntithesis (disposable vs. retained value hierarchy), and conviction reads both at principle-grade (unhedged, creed-like, asserted rather than argued). No tension between the pair — src-3 deepens src-2's distinction rather than complicating it. src-1 and src-4 sit outside this read: src-1 is meta-description of the note's tooling function (conviction: notion, not principle), and src-4 is a claim-level restatement ABOUT the thesis for a downstream extractor rather than a performance of the thesis itself — its conviction and register do not match the principle-grade aphoristic pair.
